TraitDef.label: door enthusiast
TraitDef.description: Admires doors; gains a door satisfaction need and suffers grief when colony doors are destroyed.

li.label: door enthusiast
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} has an unusual appreciation for doors. The more doors the colony has, the happier they become.

NeedDef.label: door satisfaction
NeedDef.description: How content this pawn is with the colony's doors.

li.label: utterly exposed
li.description: I feel vulnerable without any doors.

li.label: very unsafe
li.description: A couple of doors barely keep me safe; I need more.

li.label: uneasy
li.description: I feel only a little safer, but I still long for more doors.

li.label: somewhat secure
li.description: There are some doors placed; I feel a bit safer.

li.label: adequately secure
li.description: There are enough doors to feel reasonably safe.

li.label: secure
li.description: These doors give me a real sense of security.

li.label: fortified and safe
li.description: I'm completely at ease with so many doors around me!

li.label: lost a door
li.description: One of my colony doors was destroyed. I miss its reassuring presence.

li.label: lost a strong door
li.description: A sturdy door I admired was destroyed. It feels like losing a friend.
